Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
About the job
 Wipro Romania, part of global IT and consulting leader Wipro Ltd., has grown significantly since 2007. With over 2000 employees from 21+ nationalities, it supports 50+ clients, offering a collaborative, inclusive work environment and professional growth opportunities.
 Type of contract: permanent employment / full time employment on CIM 
 Duration of contract: undetermined 
 Model of working: Hybrid: 3 days / week at Wipro office in Bucharest 
 Schedule: standard schedule from Monday to Friday, also rotational on-call (1 week / month) 
 Role Overview: 
 The CyberArk PAM Administrator will manage and maintain an existing on-premises CyberArk Privileged Access Management environment. The role includes day-to-day operations, onboarding new privileged accounts and systems (Windows, Linux, Unix, and network devices), ensuring system health, applying patches, and supporting compliance and security audits.
 Key Responsibilities: 
Monitor and maintain CyberArk components: EPV, PVWA, CPM, PSM, PSMP, PTA.
Perform regular health checks, apply patches, and manage upgrades.
Ensure high availability and disaster recovery readiness.
Onboard privileged accounts and integrate Windows, Linux, Unix, and network devices into CyberArk PAM.
Configure password rotation policies and session recording for these platforms.
Conduct periodic audits and generate compliance reports.
Ensure adherence to least privilege principles and regulatory standards.
Investigate and resolve security alerts from PTA and SIEM integrations.
Maintain integrations with AD, SIEM, and other enterprise systems.
Troubleshoot issues related to connectivity, authentication, and session management.
Provide L2/L3 support for CyberArk-related incidents and service requests.
Develop scripts for account onboarding and lifecycle management.
Optimize workflows for efficiency and scalability
 Required Skills & Experience: 
Hands-on experience with CyberArk on-premises components (EPV, PVWA, CPM, PSM, PSMP, PTA).
Strong understanding of PAM operational best practices.
Expertise in onboarding Windows, Linux, Unix, and network devices.
Experience in patching, upgrades, and DR drills.
Knowledge of scripting (PowerShell, Python) for automation.
 Certifications (Preferred): 
CyberArk Certified
CISSP or equivalent security certifications.
 Soft Skills: 
Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
Good communication and documentation skills.
 Benefits for working with us: 
Competitive salary with attractive set of social benefits:
Private Pension Plan;
Monthly Benefit budget;
Medical insurance;
Life insurance;
Christmas bonus;
Childbirth allowance;
Relocation package for candidates willing to relocate;
Great career opportunity to work for one of the biggest brands in the world in a unique work environment;
Personal development in a multinational working environment through nice extracurricular activities with the team;
Platform to actively participate and make an impact through Sustainability and Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) projects;
Professional development through a variety of training programs (hard/soft skills within WILearn/Udemy platforms);
Extra annual leave days depending on tenure within Wipro;
BOOKSTER opportunities;
Nice designed and central business office;
Fruits, coffee and tea on the house;
Winner Circle Points (WCP) & Long service award (LSA) platforms which offers the possibility of both non-monetary and monetary recognition;
 Employee Assistance program; 
 Employee Referral Program with attractive incentive schemes
The promise of an enjoyable first impression after discussing with any of our recruitment colleagues.
 This position offers a chance to be part of a forward-thinking company that values innovation and a progressive approach to technology. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply and join the team where they can make a significant impact.
 Wipro is an advocate for positive change and conscious inclusion. As a global employer, we strive to create a diverse Wipro family by remaining committed to the development of our culture, diversity, equality, and inclusion in the workplace. All applicants welcome.
